title: 雄猫支援线（核心人物往来之一）

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [NICE! I DIDN'T KNOW YOU STILL COLLECTED COSMOCARDS!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [不错！我不知道你还在收集宇宙卡！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [I DON'T! BUT IT SEEMS LIKE SOME DWEEB DROPPED ONE.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [我才不收！不过好像有个窝囊废掉了一张。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [AND IT LOOKS CONVENIENTLY LIKE SOME LOCAL FAUNA.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [而且碰巧长得像本地的某种动物。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THAT'S GREAT! OPEN YOUR P.A.W. TO THE COSMOCARD MENU]
rows.current: Tomcat: [太好了！打开你的 P.A.W.，进到宇宙卡菜单，你应该就能把卡片翻过来，这样就能提前知道你会怎么被干-]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [AND YOU SHOULD BE ABLE TO FLIP THE CARDS OVER]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WHICH WILL GIVE YOU A HEADS UP ON HOW YOU'LL BE FU-]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [OH WOW IS THAT A TUTONE COSMOCARD? FOR REAL, AGENT?]
rows.current: Mauser: [哦哇，那是图托恩宇宙卡？真的吗，特工？]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [THOSE ARE PROLLY WORTH BIG CREDITS WHEN YOU RETURN]
rows.current: Mauser: [等你回去，那些大概值不少信用点，当然也会有对你任务有用的信息！]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [AND OF COURSE WILL HAVE USEFUL INFO FOR YOUR MISSION!]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [NO DOUBT, SQUEAKS. YOU KNOW, TOMCAT IS A HUGE FAN]
rows.current: Yiffany: [那还用说，小吱吱。你知道，雄猫也超喜欢宇宙卡。你们俩何不聊聊这个？]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [OF COSMOCARDS TOO. WHY DON'T YOU TWO CHAT ABOUT EM?]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [REALLY TOMCAT? I DIDN'T KNOW! LEMME GET MY COLLECTION]
rows.current: Mauser: [真的吗，雄猫？我不知道！我去拿我的收藏]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [I'VE GOT COMPLETE SETS OF MULTIPLE PLANETARY SYSTEMS-]
rows.current: Mauser: [我有好几个行星系的完整套装-]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [AHHH, WELL... THAT SOUNDS... LIKE REAL FUN...]
rows.current: Tomcat: [啊，这个……听起来……真有意思……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THANKS FOR HOOKING US UP, GRRRL...]
rows.current: Tomcat: [谢你牵线，丫头……]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [ANYTIME, HAVE A NICE CARD DATE! TEEHEE!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [不客气，祝你们的卡片约会愉快！嘻嘻！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [AWWW THAT'S ADORABLE! I DIDN'T KNOW YOU PUPS WERE]
rows.current: Tomcat: [哇，好可爱！我都不知道你们这些小家伙还在收集宇宙卡！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [STILL INTO COSMOCARDS!]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [I-I'M NOT! I JUST HAPPENED TO STUMBLE ACROSS ONE!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [我、我才没有！我只是刚好碰巧发现了一张！]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [AGENT, YOU'RE NOT A COLLECTOR? ARE YOU SERIOUS?]
rows.current: Mauser: [特工，你不是收集者？你是认真的吗？]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [ANY COSMOBREEDER WORTH THEIR CREDITS WOULD KNOW THAT]
rows.current: Mauser: [任何够格的宇宙育种者都知道，宇宙卡是很棒的情报来源，尤其是来自陌生星球的卡牌！]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [COSMOCARDS ARE GREAT SOURCES OF INFORMATION]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [ESPECIALLY IF THE CARDS ARE FOR AN UNFAMILIAR PLANET!]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [WELL, I MEAN... THEY ARE KINDA COOL LOOKING...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [唔，我是说……它们看起来确实挺酷的……]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [OF COURSE THEY ARE! AND NOT ONLY THAT, BUT THEY WILL HAVE]
rows.current: Mauser: [那当然了！不止如此，卡上还会印有有用的敌方数据！]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [USEFUL ENEMY DATA ON THEM AS WELL!]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [AND IF YOU FEEL LIKE BEING A LITTLE NAUGHTY...]
rows.current: Tomcat: [要是你想稍微淘气一下……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [OPEN UP THE COSMOCARD VIEWER SUB MENU IN YOUR P.A.W.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [在你的 P.A.W. 里打开宇宙卡查看器的子菜单。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [AND FLIP THE CARD AROUND TO THE BACK, HEHE!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [然后把卡翻到背面，嘿嘿！]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [N-NAUGHTY? I DUNNO ABOUT THAT, BUT TH-THESE SOUND LIKE]
rows.current: Yiffai: [淘、淘气？这个倒不太懂，不过这、这些听起来倒是像很有用的研究途径。伊吠完毕！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THAAAT'S RIGHT! SATELLITE R18 HAS A CONSTANT STREAM OF]
rows.current: Tomcat: [就——是这样！卫星 R18 一直在把你的近场数据传回总部。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [IT'S A LOW LATENCY SMALL DATA STREAM SATELLITE]
rows.current: Tomcat: [那是一颗低延迟小数据流卫星，不过刚——好能把我们连上。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [BUT IT'S JUUUST ABLE TO CONNECT US TOGETHER.]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [THAT MEANS YOU CAN GIVE ME INFORMATION]
rows.current: Yiffany: [那就是说，我捡到新装备时，你能给我相关信息，对吧？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [GOOD LUCK OUT THERE GIRL! HOPE YOU FIND SOME PANTS SOON!]

rows.speaker: Tomcat

rows.speaker: Yiffany

rows.speaker: Tomcat

rows.speaker: Tomcat

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THOSE OLD FASHIONED THINGS HAVE LONG SINCE BEEN RETIRED]
rows.current: Tomcat: [那些老古董早就淘汰了，都改用生物识别了。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [IN FAVOR OF BIOMETRICS.]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [GOOD TO KNOW, BUT... HOW DID YOU KNOW I GOT IT?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [明白了，可是……你怎么知道我捡到了？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THERE'S A LOW LATENCY SMALL DATA STREAM SATELLITE]
rows.current: Tomcat: [有颗低延迟、低数据量的通信卫星，刚——好能联系到你那边。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [JUUUUST ABLE TO CONNECT WITH YOU OUT THERE.]

rows.speaker: Tomcat

rows.current: Tomcat: [R18卫星正持续把你的近场数据传回总部。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [NEAR-FIELD DATA BACK HERE TO HEADQUARTERS.]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [INTERPRETTING YOUR EQUIPMENT SITUATION IS MY JOB!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [分析你的装备情况就是我的工作！]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [NEAT, SO YOU CAN FILL ME IN ON ANY NEW GEAR I GET?]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [MARK WHAT MODELS?]

rows.speaker: Mauser

rows.speaker: Tomcat

rows.current: Tomcat: [不——错，你知道的，人人都会盯着看的！]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [NOBODY HERE IN HQ CAN AFFORD THE MARK III COSMOBOOTS]
rows.current: Mauser: [总部这儿没人买得起马克 III 宇宙靴，更别说那双了！那可是顶配！]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [NEVERMIND THOSE ONES! THEY'RE TOP OF THE LINE!]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [ARE YOU TWO HAVING A MOMENT? SHOULD I LEAVE YOU ALONE?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [你们俩在培养感情吗？要我避开吗？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [YOU'RE JOKING, RIGHT? WHAT SORT OF AGENT ARE YA?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [你在开玩笑吧？你算哪门子特工？]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [THE KIND THAT DOESN'T HAVE A SHOE FETISH, I GUESS?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [大概是没有鞋子性癖的那种？]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [THOSE AREN'T JUST SHOES]
rows.current: Mauser: [那不只是鞋子]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [NO?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [不是吗？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [YEAH, THEY'RE /EXPENSIVE/ SHOES! LIMITED EDITIONS!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [对，它们是/昂贵的/鞋！限量版！]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [BUT ON TOP OF THAT THEY'LL LET YOU DO COOL DIVE KICKS!]
rows.current: Mauser: [而且它们还能让你使出很酷的俯冲踢！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [YEAH, GIVE IT A TRY NEXT TIME YOU JUMP AROUND.]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [PRESS DOWN + JUMP WHILE ALREADY IN THE AIR]
rows.current: Tomcat: [在已经腾空时按 DOWN + JUMP，你就会做出一次俯冲踢；如果接触到任何会承受伤害的东西，还会把你向上弹起。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [AND YOU'LL DO A DIVEKICK THAT WILL ALSO BOUNCE YOU UP]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [IF YOU MAKE CONTACT WITH ANYTHING THAT TAKES DAMAGE.]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [ALRIGHT, THAT SORT OF INFO IS MORE MY SPEED!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [好，这种实用情报才对我的胃口！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [TIME TO GIVE THIS DIVEKICKING THING A TEST RUN.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [是时候试试这俯冲踢了。]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [YUP, JUST REMEMBER THAT DOWN + JUMP WILL ONLY DIVEKICK]
rows.current: Mauser: [对，记住 DOWN + JUMP 只有在你身处半空时才会使出俯冲踢！]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [WHILE YOU'RE MID-AIR!]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [NO ELEVATED HEART RATE...]
rows.current: Tomcat: [心率没升高……]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [HUH? WHAT? WHY'D YOU CALL ME U-]
rows.current: Yiffai: [啊？什么？你打电话来干什——]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [BLOOD PRESSURE'S FINE, NOT EVEN ANY EYE MOVEMENT...]
rows.current: Tomcat: [血压正常，连眼动都没有……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [BUT SOMETHING'S WRONG WITH YOU, PUP.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [可你不太对劲啊，小狗崽。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [WHAT ARE YOU TALKING ABOUT?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [你在说什么？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [ANY OTHER FIELD AGENT WHO SUDDENLY BECAME AN OWNER]
rows.current: Tomcat: [换成别的外勤特工，突然弄到一双 Mark IV Cosmoboots，早就兴奋得发疯了！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [OF A PAIR OF MARK IV COSMOBOOTS]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WOULD BE ABSOLUTELY HYSTERICAL!]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [...YOU MEAN THESE SHOES THAT I JUST HAD TOSSED AT ME?]
